events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the sequence file, its history and folder
events.input: $ wc -l workshop-plan/sequences/pre.md workshop-plan/COPY_RULES.md && cat workshop-plan/sequences/pre.md && git log --oneline -8 -- workshop-plan/sequences/pre.md && ls workshop-plan/sequences/

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find code that reads the sequence file
events.input: $ grep -rn "pre\.md" --include=*.py --include=*.ts --include=*.mjs --include=*.sh --include=*.md workshop-plan/sequences workshop-plan/ops cloud/src app/scripts 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^workshop-plan/sequences/pre.md" | cut -c1-220 | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the builder, drift check and sent reminder copy
events.input: $ cat workshop-plan/sequences/build_nurture.py | head -90; echo ----; cat workshop-plan/sequences/check_confirmation.py | head -60; echo ----; grep -n "" cloud/src/reminder-copy.ts | cut -c1-400 | head -80

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find readers of the file, VIP page facts and Day 0 card names
events.input: $ grep -rln "pre\.md" workshop-plan/sequences workshop-plan/ops cloud/src app/scripts app/src 2>/dev/null | head; echo ----; ls app/src/app/vip 2>/dev/null; grep -rhoiE ">[^<>{}]{25,200}<" app/src/app/vip 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo ----; grep -rn "day0\|Day 0\|\"start\"" app/src/lib/cards*.ts 2>/dev/null | head -15

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the builder tail, sent reminder copy, VIP offer facts and card sources
events.input: $ F=/Users/adithyamurali/.claude/projects/-Users-adithyamurali-tantra-redesign/a97712e7-8fb9-4c49-a661-95e09dc6e4ea/tool-results/b3ohypic3.txt; sed -n 26,60p $F | cut -c1-300; echo; grep -n "dayBefore\|oneHour\|day_before\|one_hour\|hour\|tomorrow" cloud/src/reminder-copy.ts | cut -c1-420 | head -20; echo ---- VIP; grep -n "\"\|'" app/src/app/vip/vip-client.tsx | grep -iE "replay|bonus|template|plan|playbook|prompt|\\$|price|includes|get" | cut -c1-260 | head -30; echo ---- cards; grep -rln "Describe your business\|Choose your tools" app/src cloud/src 2>/dev/null | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: List the Day 0 cards and the VIP page claims
events.input: $ grep -n "title:\|day:\|phase:" app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts | cut -c1-200 | head -40; echo ---- VIP; grep -vE "^\s*(import|//|const \w+ = use|\}|\{|<div|</div|className)" app/src/app/vip/vip-client.tsx | grep -E "[A-Za-z]{4,} [a-z]{2,} [a-z]{2,}" | cut -c1-260 | head -60

events.name: Bash
events.head: Pull the VIP offer stack and the Start card wording
events.input: $ grep -nE "title:|name:|label:|<h[1-3]|<li|<strong" app/src/app/vip/vip-client.tsx | cut -c1-230 | head -40; grep -n "Start cards\|Day 0" app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts cloud/src/reminder-copy.ts | cut -c1-200 | head -8; sed -n 278,300p app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts | cut -c1-260
